beforeSql:
SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
ORDER BY freight_value DESC NULLS LAST, order_id, order_item_id
LIMIT 5;
afterSql:
SELECT order_id, order_item_id, freight_value
FROM order_items
ORDER BY freight_value DESC
LIMIT 5;

beforeSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(review_comment_title) <> '';
afterSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM order_reviews
WHERE review_comment_title IS NOT NULL
  AND review_comment_title <> '';

beforeSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE ml.level_name = '黄金';
afterSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS member_count
FROM members m
JOIN member_levels ml ON ml.level_id = m.level_id
WHERE ml.level_name = '黄金会员';

beforeSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name
FROM warehouses
ORDER BY capacity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;
afterSql:
SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_name, capacity
FROM warehouses
ORDER BY capacity DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;

beforeSql:
SELECT product_category_name, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1500
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

afterSql:
SELECT p.product_category_name AS category,
       COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

beforeSql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 4) AS refund_order_ratio FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id LIMIT 201

SELECT rl.level_name AS referrer_level,
       il.level_name AS invitee_level,
       COUNT(*) AS referral_count,
       ROUND(SUM(r.reward_amount), 2) AS total_reward
FROM referrals r
JOIN members rm ON rm.member_id = r.referrer_member_id
JOIN member_levels rl ON rl.level_id = rm.level_id
JOIN members im ON im.member_id = r.invitee_member_id
JOIN member_levels il ON il.level_id = im.level_id
GROUP BY rl.level_name, il.level_name
ORDER BY referral_count DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_rate
FROM order_reviews r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY low_score_rate DESC, c.customer_state
LIMIT 10;
